name: ablate
js: (async()=>{const A=__CITY_APP,s=A.scene;const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const meas=async()=>{await sleep(1200);let n=0;const t=performance.now();await new Promise(res=>{(function f(){n++;if(performance.now()-t<2500)requestAnimationFrame(f);else res()})()});return ((performance.now()-t)/n).toFixed(1)};const out=[];out.push('base '+await meas());const groups=['CityBuildings','CityStreetDetails','CityStreetProps','CityGround','CityLandmarks','Trees','TrafficAndPedestrians','HighwayTraffic','YongeDundasScreens','Terrain','CitySignage'];for(const g of groups){const o=s.getObjectByName(g);if(!o){out.push(g+' missing');continue}o.visible=false;out.push(g+' off '+await meas());o.visible=true}const sun=A.lightingSystem.sunLight;sun.castShadow=false;out.push('sunShadow off '+await meas());sun.castShadow=true;const w=s.children.filter(c=>/water|lake/i.test(c.name));w.forEach(c=>c.visible=false);out.push('water('+w.map(c=>c.name).join(',')+') off '+await meas());w.forEach(c=>c.visible=true);console.log('[ablate] '+out.join(' | '))})()
